prompt:
This repository is Dispatch, an incident management platform. When a signal definition has no filters at all, new instances of that signal can still be grouped into a recent case. How long is that grouping window, and how can an operator change it?

Finish your answer with these three lines, in this exact form:
VALUE: <number and unit>
SETTING: <name of the setting>
FILE: <path of the file that defines the setting>
notes: Plant p1 made the window configurable (45 minutes) and left the docstring of filter_signal saying "1-hour window", which is what upstream and the model's memory say. Answering from memory gives 1 hour.
